description: Fetch one PORTUGUESE awarded contract by its "idcontrato" (returned from pt_contract_search). Returns the full record: buyer and supplier (with NIF tax numbers), full title and description, amount, base procurement price, CPV codes, execution deadline, execution location(s), procedure type, publish/signing/decision dates, and the legal regime cited.

idcontrato.description: The contract's id, e.g. "12026866". Returned by pt_contract_search.

name: pt_contract_detail
